entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I was hoping... I was hoping I could return it. I feel really bad about it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. To understand the situation better, can I ask, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

Oh no, it works perfectly fine. It's just... I guess I just **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** for the new year, and I honestly **don't use it** as much as I thought I would. I really needed this money for some other bills.
I completely understand. Sometimes a new device just doesn't fit into our lives the way we expect. Let me pull up your account. Can I get the email address you used for the order?
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered about 23 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. I know it's been a few weeks, which is why I was so worried. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was just hoping you could help me out.
Of course. Let me just review our return policy for you... just one moment while I check the knowledge base...
Okay, I've got it. Our policy states that you have a 90-day window for returns.
That's right. Since you received it only 23 days ago, you are well within that period. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, my gosh, that's incredible! Diana, thank you so much. That's such a huge relief. I was so stressed about this.

You're very welcome, Sam. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label to your email. Just print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and you can drop it at any post office.
I will do that this afternoon. Thank you again, you've really made my day!
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
